summary:
Iteration 5 of Elite Concierge — 3 visual/content changes verified end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (no regression on /api/health retell_configured=true, /api/contact create+intent normalization+422 validation+all-5-intents, /api/contacts list+limit+desc sort+no _id, /api/create-web-call real Retell tokens, honeypot hp- prefix + non-storage + non-counting, rate-limit 3/hr/IP returns 429 on 4th). FRONTEND landing: .powered element count is 0 (small grey 'Powered by Retell AI' caption below demo button is fully removed; the Features-section copy 'Powered by Retell AI, 40M+ calls/month' is a different element and remains intentionally per iteration-2 spec — out of scope). Pricing CTAs: [data-testid=plan-voice-cta]='Get a Quote', [data-testid=plan-chat-cta]='Book a Demo', [data-testid=plan-full-cta]="Let's Build" — all 3 are tags pointing to https://calendly.com/dombrovskakate/30min with target=_blank and rel='noopener noreferrer'. Bullet icons: .price-card li::before has borderRadius=0px, backgroundImage=none (no radial gradient/no radio circle), transform=matrix(0.707107,-0.707107,0.707107,0.707107,0,0) which is rotate(-45deg), border-left=2px solid rgb(236,28,140) AND border-bottom=2px solid rgb(236,28,140), width=14px height=9px — clean accent-pink stroke checkmark. Pricing section .section-head computed text-align='center' and contains 'Built Around Your Business, Not a Generic Plan.'. Footer trust strip: .footer-trust exists with exactly 4 .trust-badge children in order 'SOC 2','HIPAA','GDPR','99.99% UPTIME' (UPTIME is uppercased via CSS — base text was '99.99% Uptime'), data-testids trust-soc2/trust-hipaa/trust-gdpr/trust-uptime present, computed justify-content='center', first child of each badge is

in correct order — original SOC2+GDPR sentence, NEW compliance sentence ('Elite Concierge is built on infrastructure that is SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and GDPR compliant. These certifications apply to the underlying platform and data infrastructure used to deliver our services.'), then 72-hour breach notification sentence. /terms.html: same trust strip; section 6 'Data Processing' has exactly 2

— original DPA paragraph then the new compliance sentence appended. Mobile 420x820 on landing+privacy+terms: .footer-trust has flex-wrap=wrap, justify-content=center, width=380px <= viewport 420px (no overflow). Zero console errors on all 3 page reloads at desktop and mobile widths.
critical_code_review_comments: Trust-badge label '99.99% Uptime' renders as '99.99% UPTIME' due to CSS text-transform:uppercase — innerText therefore returns uppercase. Test spec note 'case may render uppercase via CSS' confirms this is intended; no action.

The phrase 'Powered by Retell AI' still appears in the Features section copy as 'Powered by Retell AI, 40M+ calls/month' — this is a different element from the removed .powered caption and is intentional per earlier iteration. If the goal is to scrub ALL Retell branding from the page, flag this for the main agent; otherwise no action.

index.html / privacy.html / terms.html now each have a self-contained copy of the .footer-trust block + CSS — three pages × same CSS is becoming meaningful duplication. If a 4th page is added consider extracting shared footer markup + CSS to a partial or moving to a templated build (also noted in iteration 4).
seed_data_creation: ~12 TEST_-prefixed contact docs created in MongoDB during pytest run with unique X-Forwarded-For IPs; hp- honeypot submissions correctly not stored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-5 spec items verified green with zero defects. Trust badges have data-testid='trust-soc2|trust-hipaa|trust-gdpr|trust-uptime' on all 3 pages. The .powered <div> caption was removed but Features-section body copy still mentions 'Powered by Retell AI' (intentional, different element). Pricing checkmark is a rotated-borders pseudo-element — when adding new bullets, ensure .price-card li still has padding-left to leave room for the ::before tick. Mobile widths confirmed safe at 420px (footer-trust wraps cleanly). Backend test suite (18 cases) is the regression baseline — keep using fresh_ip_headers fixture to avoid rate-limit bleed.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in iteration 5. All 3 visual/content changes (Powered-by-Retell caption removal, pricing CTAs + checkmark icons + centered headline, footer compliance trust strip + legal-page compliance paragraphs in /privacy.html section 9 and /terms.html section 6) implemented exactly to spec.
